finding: Step 4 tells VIRGIL to set agent-factory.counterRemote to the parent of the directory that `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` prints. In the main worktree, that command prints the relative `.git`, so an agent may store `.`. BR-096 and ST-0379 require the absolute path. With `.`, a claim run from a subdirectory pushes to that subdirectory and fails. Name `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` and say that the setting holds an absolute path.
why_this_severity: From the project root and from a worktree, `.` still reaches the shared repository, and an agent that resolves the parent usually writes an absolute path (no to fails_purpose); a wrong value fails only in a subdirectory, so a reader must find the cause behind an unrelated git error (raises_cost).
